programs.title: Khuddar
programs.desc: Hari is forced to marry Seema, who dislikes his stepbrothers, Govind and Rajesh. When he goes to Mumbai, she displaces them to become beggars. However, destiny reunites them with Hari in a courtroom.

programs.title: Hum Dono
programs.desc: Raja discovers that his face is similar to that of Dr Shekhar, one of the top earning doctors of Bombay. He manages to take his place, but discovers that Dr Shekhar has many problems of his own.

programs.title: Qayamat
programs.desc: Two close friends turn enemies when one becomes a criminal and the other, an IPS officer. Wronged by his friend, the criminal swears to take revenge once he returns from prison.

programs.title: Hameshaa
programs.desc: Childhood friends Yash and Raja fall in love with Rani but their jealousy leads to the death of both Raja and Rani. When Yash comes across her lookalike, his obsession leads him down a dark path.
